Ordered Harvest

Restart this deal
Another deal

A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Find your next move.

Keep a nearly profitable field or harvest early to absorb compulsory crop; trade future awkward card before it reaches hand front; gift market crop to avoid destroying a valuable field. Trade can help rival but save more own loss.

Take a seat
How to play
Two fields each hold one crop type; hand order immutable. Turn plant oldest card, optionally second oldest, reveal two market cards. Negotiate transfers of market cards and any hand cards with two bots using public wanted-crop offers; received cards must plant immediately, never enter hand. Player may exchange a selected card for an offered crop, accept/refuse; bot follows public current-field value. Harvest a field anytime for threshold coin schedule, removing it. Draw three cards to hand tail. Two deck passes.
Most coins after final mandatory harvest wins; tie draws, lower total loses.
This compact market uses one-for-one counteroffers. A 16-human-turn cap also triggers the final harvest. Bots receive market crops and draw between your turns; all received crops plant immediately.
Controls & access
The important decisions

No timer. No account. A fresh approach is always welcome.

9×9 board, seven-tile rack, finite public vocabulary searchable by prefix. Each turn place contiguous row/column word connecting existing board; every perpendicular cross-word must also be valid. Reuse existing letters, score all new words by letter values with one-use letter/word premiums. Blank chosen once at placement scores zero. Exchange selected tiles only with at least seven in bag, or pass. Draw replacements after commit.
Bag empty and one rack empty, or six combined passes, ends; subtract remaining rack values and transfer them on going out. Higher score wins; equal draw.
A 36-combined-turn cap also closes the game with normal rack adjustments. Use the public dictionary browser buttons to inspect allowed words; all placement uses native buttons, with Tab/Enter keyboard access.
